name: Starknife
description: The Starknife was a modified Kuat Drive Yards D9 Runner light freighter owned by the Duros smuggler Kalend Thora. She received the Starknife after the ship's original owner, a fellow member of Black Sun, was ambushed and killed by an unknown party.
